import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        int m = scanner.nextInt();
        System.out.println(app(n, m));
    }

    public static int egcd(int a, int b) {
        int r0 = a;
        int r1 = b;
        int s0 = 1;
        int s1 = 0;
        int t0 = 0;
        int t1 = 1;
        while (r1 != 0) {
            int q = r0 / r1;
            r0 = r1;
            r1 = r0 - q * r1;
            s0 = s1;
            s1 = s0 - q * s1;
            t0 = t1;
            t1 = t0 - q * t1;
        }
        return r0;
    }

    public static int[] tf(int n, int M) {
        int[] C = new int[n + 1];
        C[n] = 1;
        for (int k = n - 1; k >= 0; k--) {
            C[k] = (C[k + 1] * (k + 1)) % M;
            if (C[k] == 0) {
                break;
            }
        }
        return C;
    }

    public static int app(int n, int M) {
        int[][][] K = new int[n][n][n + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            int[][] Ki = K[i];
            int ni = n;
            for (int j = 0; j < ni; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < n + 1; k++) {
                    Ki[j][k] = 0;
                }
            }
            K[i + 1] = Ki;
            for (int j = 0; j < ni; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < n + 1; k++) {
                    for (int h = 0; h < i + 1; h++) {
                        K[i + 1][j + h][k] += K[i][j][k];
                        K[i + 1][j + h][k] %= M;
                    }
                    K[i + 1][j + i + 1][i + 1] += K[i][j][k];
                    K[i + 1][j + i + 1][i + 1] %= M;
                }
            }
        }

        int[] C = tf(n, M);
        int s = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int[][] Ki = K[i];
            int ni = n;
            int mi = n + 1;
            int[][] Si = new int[ni][mi];
            for (int j = 0; j < ni; j++) {
                Si[j][mi - 1] = Ki[j][mi - 1];
                for (int k = mi - 2; k >= 0; k--) {
                    Si[j][k] = (Ki[j][k] + Si[j][k + 1]) % M;
                }
            }
            for (int j = 1; j < ni; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < mi; k++) {
                    Si[j][k] += Si[j - 1][k];
                    Si[j][k] %= M;
                }
            }

            int si = 0;
            for (int j = 1; j < ni; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < mi - 1; k++) {
                    si += (Ki[j][k] * Si[j - 1][k + 1]) % M;
                    si %= M;
                }
            }

            int c = C[i + 1];
            si *= c;
            si %= M;
            s += si;
            s %= M;
        }
        return s;
    }
}
